package fixture

import (
	"database/sql"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

// Deliberately bypasses tests/integration/testdb.Open (ADR 0034) by reading
// the connection string out of the environment and opening it directly —
// the exact shape testdb-bypass-guard exists to reject.
// See scripts/testdata/guard-fixtures/README.md.
func TestBypass(t *testing.T) {
	db, err := sql.Open("pgx", os.Getenv("METALDOCS_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer db.Close()
}
